message: お嬢さまと僕

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mr. President. What're you doin' in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hello. Um, where's Ria-senpai--」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, how did your test go?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, w... well, I think I did decently enough」

name: Ria
message: 「I see\s04 You still have one more day left, so hang in there... okay?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes! I'll do my best!」

name: Ria
message: 「So, did you need something from me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no... that was all. Since you helped me study, I thought I should at least report back to you, Ria-senpai」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a sweet boy. Just what you'd expect from the president Rii-a raised」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Though his face says he doesn't recall being raised by you」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all! I'm really grateful to Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehehe. Hearing you say that makes me kind of shy」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why don't you give our honest, hardworking president a reward?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, that's a great idea♪」
A-A reward...? What could it be, my heart's pounding.

name: Ria
message: 「Do you have a little time after this? Oh, maybe it's tough since you have to study for your tests~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That much time! I'm totally fine!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, then it's decided♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're probably disappointed, thinking, 'Here again?'」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Forgive us. Both Rii-a and I like this place best, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「I get to have tea with two gorgeous upperclassmen. There's no way I could ever be disappointed」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, you, saying such flattery. Stop it, you」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go~ First, have some tea~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, thank you so very much」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much. *Sip*... Phew」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That Japanese sweet we spoke of. Is it ready yet?」

name: Ria
message: 「They said it'll be right out♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What's coming out?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait until it gets here and see\s04」
A voice calls out from the kitchen, and Misasagi-senpai rises from her seat.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here you are, thank you kindly for waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This is...!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's yokan sprinkled with gold leaf」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh... What!?」
I-It's so dazzling I can't look straight at it.

name: Misasagi
message: 「The appearance might be a touch garish, I suppose」

name: Ria
message: 「You think?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're thinking it's all the same once it's in your stomach, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Wha--!? I wasn't thinking anything like that!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What about you, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Pant, pant*... This is wonderful...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Spoken like the President Ria raised」

name: Ria
message: 「That has nothing to do with it!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Can I really eat this!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Of course, of course. Please do enjoy」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for the food!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm gonna dig in too~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!!」
Still, eating Japanese sweets on a Western-style terrace has its own distinct charm.
On top of that, having a tea party surrounded by two beauties like Misasagi-senpai and Ria-senpai is truly having a flower in each hand!
I'm so happy I feel like I might suffocate.
I suppose this situation is also a privilege of being the Student Council President. I can feel the prickly stares from everyone around us.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hey, Prez」
Misasagi-senpai leaned forward.
And then she stared intently at my face.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really do look just like him」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yukkun, the celebrity」
Oh, Nanaka was talking about that guy.

name: Synn
message: 「He's in *Ai no Yoromeki no Yatsura* right now, isn't he. Playing the protagonist's younger stepbrother or something」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yeah, that's the one, that's the one」

name: Ria
message: 「Really~~? I don't think they look *that* much alike」

name: Misasagi
message: 「True. Prez here might actually be the cuter one」

name: Ria
message: 「Heeey. It's rude to call a boy cute, you know」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, it's the truth. The way he triggers your maternal instincts is the spitting image of him」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~. Personally, I think Teppei-kun looks more like him」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ah, because they both seem a little masochistic?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I never said anything like that!」
Listening to them chat about celebrities like this makes me realize that even two high-class young ladies like them are just ordinary girls at heart.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, you know. He might not seem like you based on the roles he plays, but when you meet Yukkun in person, he's your dead ringer!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~~」
Huh? Even Ria-senpai has a totally normal reaction.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Teppei-kun is actually quite flashy in his private life, you see」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... So he really is like that」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... You're casually talking about a celebrity's private life, though」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hm?」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me you've actually met him in person!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Every now and then」
S-She really was a rich young lady!!

name: Ria
message: 「Not me at all, though\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a has no interest in showbiz, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Celebrities are fun because you watch them on TV」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. That's just like you, Rii-a」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's amazing... Being friends with celebrities...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Friends? It's nothing like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We're merely acquaintances. My friends are Rii-a and everyone in class」

name: Ria
message: 「And Synn-kun too, right♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right」

name: Misasagi
message: 「We're only socializing because of our family backgrounds... I wish they'd at least let me choose my own friends myself」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, Akane-chan... You can't really help it\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
I guess even rich young ladies have their own kind of troubles.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mind you, when it comes to meeting famous people, Rii-a is actually way more impressive」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Apparently she's met the Prime Minister before」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, Akane-chan. That's supposed to be a secret!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Why's that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Because~~ It's not like I actually wanted to meet him or anything~~」
Meeting the Prime Minister when she didn't even want to--what kind of chain of events led to that...

name: Ria
message: 「If I had to choose, I'd rather be friends with more mysterious people than important or famous ones」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Don't tell me you're gonna say you want aliens, people from another world, or espers as friends?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~. That might actually be pretty close」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. That definitely sounds like it'd be more fun」
I'm neither a celebrity nor the Prime Minister, though by the way she just put it, wouldn't I qualify?
After all, I'm the ruler of the Demon World--the Demon Lord!
...Even though I've never actually lived in the Demon World.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Speaking of which, don't you already have loads of friends like that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah~~, true. There's Lolotte-chan, Sally-chan, everyone in the Delicious Food Squad, and Eauderourke-chan, for starters」
So Ria-senpai knew about Lolotte's true identity too.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm so jealous. Having all kinds of friends like that」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you'll become good friends with them right away too, Misasagi-senpai」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Really?」

name: Ria
message: 「Really, really」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is that so~」

name: Ria
message: 「Having lots of friends is way more fun, after all♪」

name: Synn
message: 「It sure is」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, now that I've had my tea, I really oughta get back to studying」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, do your best」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you studying for entrance exams, Misasagi-senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not that, imperial studies. Terribly sorry for the intrusion」

name: Ria
message: 「Bye-bye」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Goodbye~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai wants to become an emperor...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not what it means\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan is the heir to her family, after all. Once she graduates from Ryuusei Academy, she'll start working right away as the successor」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Come to think of it, what are your plans after graduation, Ria-senpai----」

name: Ria
message: 「For now, going on to university, I guess. I've already got a recommendation」

name: Synn
message: 「Impressive as always, Ria-senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, which university?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, there's also Re-Crea to worry about. I picked somewhere I can commute to from Ryuusei Town as much as possible」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
And that's why Helena-san is the chairwoman at her age too....

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing, it just struck me how you, Helena-san, and Misasagi-senpai all have constraints on your futures」

name: Ria
message: 「It might look that way, yeah. Still, it's not like we aren't allowed any freedom」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Normally, Akane-chan wouldn't even commute to school--she'd be getting elite tutoring at home」

name: Ria
message: 「My big sister even skipped grades to study abroad, so we actually get to do plenty of what we want」

name: Ria
message: 「And right now, I'm having fun doing Student Council activities together with everyone like this!」
Out of her few free choices, Ria-senpai chose to spend her time with us.
Sometimes, it makes me feel uneasy.
Even if Ria-senpai was the one who asked us to help exterminate demons, we've ended up dragging her into everyday Student Council duties too.
If only we were more reliable, maybe Ria-senpai could have enjoyed even more freedom.
I wonder if it's really okay for us to monopolize what little freedom she has.

name: Ria
message: 「What's the matter? You've been looking down for a while now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no...」

name: Ria
message: 「If something's bothering you, tell your senpai all about it♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to spend even more time with you, Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」
Giving in to negative thoughts and saying something like that out of nowhere!?

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not just me. Everyone else has to feel the same way」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, ahaha, right, right. You're right~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I only have a few months left to spend with everyone......」
Ria-senpai murmured wistfully while holding her teacup.

name: Ria
message: 「Things are so fun right now that I can't help wishing time would just stop~」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, though. We can't keep doing Student Council forever」

name: Ria
message: 「The time will come when it ends. I have to graduate」
Every single minute and second we spend happily together is constantly ticking away, never to be reclaimed, yet--.

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, our bond won't end. Right?」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, I really love your house, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, why is that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because that's a place where everyone can gather no matter how much time passes」

name: Ria
message: 「Even after Student Council is over, I thought that as long as everyone gathers there, we can go back to our Student Council days whenever we want」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehehe...... sorry. For forcing my own selfish wish onto you like that\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it makes me happy. Hearing that about a house with nothing in it...... where I practically live all alone......」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's all get together again and do all kinds of things, okay\s04」
After that, we kept talking until dusk about what we should do for our upcoming Student Council activities.
So that we could make our bond even stronger during the little time Ria-senpai had left to participate.
